# 🔨 TestForge

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-orange.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.12+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.12+-blue.svg)](https://python.org)
[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-0.115-green.svg)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com)
[![MiMo Orbit](https://img.shields.io/badge/MiMo%20Orbit-Variant%20%2310-red.svg)](https://github.com/NousResearch)

**Multi-Agent Automated Solidity Test Suite Builder** — Upload a Solidity contract, get a complete Foundry test suite generated by 5 specialized AI agents working in parallel.

> 🏆 Built for the **MiMo Orbit** grant program. Variant #10 of mass submission. Powered by [MiMo](https://github.com/NousResearch).

---

## ✨ Features

- **5 Specialized AI Agents** running in parallel:
  - 🧪 **Unit Test Generator** — tests every public function
  - 🔗 **Integration Test Generator** — cross-contract interaction tests
  - 🎲 **Fuzz Test Generator** — Foundry property-based fuzz tests
  - ⚡ **Edge Case Generator** — boundary conditions, reentrancy, max uint
  - 🎭 **Mock Generator** — mock contracts and test helpers
- **Synthesis Agent** — merges all outputs into a clean, deduplicated test suite
- **Token Usage Tracking** — SQLite-persistent, per-agent breakdown
- **Web UI** — drag-and-drop Solidity upload with real-time progress
- **REST API** — integrate into CI/CD pipelines
- **Docker Ready** — one-command deployment

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    TestForge Pipeline                │
│                                                     │
│  Solidity ──► Chunk ──┬─► Unit Tests        ──┐     │
│              Source   ├─► Integration Tests   ──┤     │
│                       ├─► Fuzz Tests          ──┼─► Synthesis ──► Test Suite
│                       ├─► Edge Case Tests     ──┤     │
│                       └─► Mock Contracts      ──┘     │
│                                                     │
│  Token Tracker (SQLite) ◄── each agent reports      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.12+
- OpenAI API key (or compatible endpoint)

### Local Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Oberonn0x/testforge.git
cd testforge
python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your API key
uvicorn backend.app:app --reload
```

Open [http://localhost:8000](http://localhost:8000)

### Docker

```bash
cp .env.example .env  # Edit with your API key
docker-compose up --build
```

## 📡 API

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/generate` | POST | Submit Solidity code (JSON body) |
| `/api/generate/upload` | POST | Upload `.sol` file |
| `/api/generate/{id}` | GET | Get job status & results |
| `/api/stats` | GET | Token usage statistics |

### Example

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"solidity_code": "pragma solidity ^0.8.0; contract Counter { uint256 public x; function inc() external { x++; } }"}'
```

## 📊 Token Consumption

TestForge tracks every LLM API call with full transparency:

- **Per-agent tracking**: See exactly how many tokens each agent consumed
- **Persistent storage**: SQLite database survives restarts
- **Live dashboard**: View stats at `/api/stats` or on the web UI

Typical generation: **6 API calls** (5 agents + 1 synthesis), ~15K-40K tokens total depending on contract complexity.

## 📁 Project Structure

```
testforge/
├── backend/
│   ├── agents/
│   │   ├── base.py                    # Shared LLM caller + retry + tracking
│   │   ├── unit_test_generator.py     # Agent 1: Unit tests
│   │   ├── integration_test_generator.py  # Agent 2: Integration tests
│   │   ├── fuzz_test_generator.py     # Agent 3: Fuzz tests
│   │   ├── edge_case_generator.py     # Agent 4: Edge cases
│   │   ├── mock_generator.py          # Agent 5: Mocks
│   │   └── synthesis.py              # Synthesis agent
│   ├── app.py                         # FastAPI application
│   ├── pipeline.py                    # Orchestration pipeline
│   └── token_tracker.py              # SQLite token tracking
├── frontend/
│   └── index.html                     # Web UI
├── docs/
│   ├── ARCHITECTURE.md
│   └── EXAMPLE_RUN.md
├── proofs/
├── Dockerfile
├── docker-compose.yml
├── requirements.txt
├── .env.example
├── .gitignore
└── LICENSE
```

## 🧪 Output Format

TestForge generates a complete Foundry test suite:

```
test/
├── Unit.t.sol           # Unit tests for all public functions
├── Integration.t.sol    # Cross-contract interaction tests
├── Fuzz.t.sol           # Property-based fuzz tests
├── EdgeCase.t.sol       # Boundary condition tests
├── mocks/
│   └── Mocks.sol        # Mock contracts
└── helpers/
    └── TestHelpers.sol  # Shared test utilities
```
